lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn6Cd2O8 (reduced formula Zn3CdO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2 (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows octahedral Zn centers coordinated by six O neighbors (distances 2.01–2.11 Å) and tetrahedral Cd centers coordinated by four O neighbors (2.06–2.16 Å). The Zn octahedra and Cd tetrahedra share corners, and Zn octahedra also share edges, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
